surfaces.instruction: Managed block directly in $CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md (no @include), skills at ~/.agents/skills

codex.precedence: user AGENTS.md content is preserved; the managed block is replaced by ownership marker
codex.reload: start_new_task (new task picks up AGENTS.md and skills)
codex.mergeStrategy: marked-block atomic swap for AGENTS.md; exact-hash skill projection; line patch for MCP TOML
codex.installStrategy: detect a live Codex binary; transactionally install AGENTS.md, native skills and selected MCP registrations; retire owned callback entries
codex.readbackStrategy: AGENTS.md managed bytes + skill parity + native MCP config/list when available
codex.canaryStrategy: credential-free static byte readback; authenticated model behavior remains NEEDS_USER until observed in a live session
codex.uninstallStrategy: remove only managed block/files by ownership hash; preserve user content; verify readback no longer contains managed block
limits: Codex has no desktop install root signal; config dir alone is not proof

surfaces.skill: ~/.claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md + shared ~/.agents/skills when supported but Claude prefers ~/.claude/skills

claude.precedence: user CLAUDE.md content and unrelated settings are preserved
claude.mergeStrategy: markdown managed block swap; exact-hash skill projection; native MCP merge
claude.installStrategy: detect `claude` binary + config dir; inventory owned vs unmanaged; atomic swap + native readback (parse settings.json, mcp list, skill count)
claude.readbackStrategy: parse CLAUDE.md managed block + `claude mcp list` + skill inventory; version diagnostic only
claude.canaryStrategy: credential-free static config + MCP list + owned-file hashes; authenticated behavior remains host-owned
claude.uninstallStrategy: remove managed block, owned skills and MCP entries that match ownership hashes only
limits: Claude settings.json is JSONC with comments; do not stringify whole file; model turn needs session

surfaces.skill: ~/.grok/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md or shared Claude-compatible path when compatibility kept

grok.precedence: inventory all Claude/Cursor entries Grok reads; if all entries of cell are agent-rules owned → disable compatibility and use .grok direct; if user unmanaged entries exist → keep compatibility and use exactly one Claude-compatible projection; never duplicate .grok + Claude copy
grok.mergeStrategy: compatibility-aware: only write to winning cell; preserve unmanaged user entries; atomic swap in target cell
grok.installStrategy: install native rules, skills and MCP surfaces; remove only ownership-proven legacy callback entries
grok.readbackStrategy: `grok inspect --json` when available plus rules/skills/MCP inventory
grok.canaryStrategy: credential-free static rules/skills/MCP readback; behavioral proof needs an authenticated observed session
grok.uninstallStrategy: remove from winning cell only (direct or compatibility); restore compatibility flag if it was disabled; preserve unmanaged entries
limits: Grok may read Claude/Cursor compatibility paths; never assume pure .grok isolation; model turn unavailable when signed-out

surfaces.skill: shared ~/.agents/skills (native plugin/permissions discovery) — avoid host-specific duplicate

opencode.precedence: AGENTS.md managed block + native skills + global local plugin; preserve user config and unrelated plugins
opencode.reload: restart_or_reload (local plugins load at startup; AGENTS.md applies to new sessions)
opencode.mergeStrategy: marked block for AGENTS.md; owned local plugin file; JSON preserve for opencode.json MCP entries
opencode.installStrategy: detect binary `opencode` + $OPENCODE_HOME; install managed AGENTS.md block, native skills, owned local plugin, and selected MCP registrations
opencode.readbackStrategy: AGENTS.md block + skill inventory + native MCP config/readback
opencode.canaryStrategy: credential-free: native config/debug/skill readback + MCP handshake; if auth: headless prompt nonce
opencode.uninstallStrategy: remove managed AGENTS.md block + MCP bridge entry owned only; delete plugin shim if created

antigravity.cliSignal: agy --version (Antigravity CLI) via official Windows installer, absolute path when PATH stale

surfaces.skill: IDE and CLI native skill surfaces (shared/host-specific per discovery requirement)
surfaces.mcp: $ANTIGRAVITY_HOME/mcp_config.json + IDE UI + CLI `agy mcp list` equivalent

antigravity.precedence: IDE and CLI surfaces separate; IDE GEMINI.md block + IDE config UI; CLI config path separate; user IDE config preserved via marked block/JSON patch
antigravity.reload: restart_or_reload (IDE reload window; CLI agy restart); IDE config/UI/log readback
antigravity.mergeStrategy: IDE GEMINI.md managed block + IDE config JSON patch; CLI config patch; never merge IDE+CLI into one hash
antigravity.installStrategy: detect IDE via ~/.gemini + agy binary via absolute official path; install IDE projection (GEMINI.md block + skills/MCP) and CLI projection separately; never open login flow
antigravity.readbackStrategy: IDE config/UI/log readback + CLI `agy` native readback; prove IDE and CLI separately, not via single config hash
antigravity.canaryStrategy: offline static IDE/CLI config and MCP readback; authenticated model behavior remains host-owned
antigravity.uninstallStrategy: remove managed GEMINI.md block + IDE config managed entries + CLI managed entries by ownership; preserve user IDE settings
limits: IDE and CLI are dual surfaces with separate configs; do not use one hash for both; agy PATH may be stale on Windows

cursor.desktopSignal: Cursor desktop process (Cursor.exe) + local plugin host

surfaces.skill: shared ~/.agents/skills (Cursor native discovery) — exact count must match

cursor.precedence: managed rule file coexists with user rules; mcp.json user entries are preserved
cursor.mergeStrategy: owned rule file + exact-hash skills + mcp.json patch; never write .cursorrules
cursor.installStrategy: detect live Cursor binary/desktop; install owned rule file, shared skills and selected MCP registrations; retire owned callback entries
cursor.readbackStrategy: rule bytes + skill parity + mcp.json parse
cursor.canaryStrategy: credential-free full native proof listed above; MODEL_BEHAVIOR is NEEDS_USER when Cursor not logged in (never fake PASS)
cursor.uninstallStrategy: remove managed plugin files/entries by ownership hash; preserve user plugin entries; verify manifest still parseable
limits: Cursor model turn unavailable when signed-out; plugin manifest load log is native readback, not version string

deepseek-harness.precedence: profile bundles then profile cordis.patch.yml; managed rows are marked and user rows preserved
deepseek-harness.mergeStrategy: native plugin add per discovered profile + marked Cordis row patch; preserve unrelated profile/package entries
deepseek-harness.installStrategy: detect `dsh` binary + DSH_HOME; discover every profile directory; patch native AGENTS/skills; when integrations are enabled install the exact @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client and marked Cordis rows
deepseek-harness.readbackStrategy: per discovered profile `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config`; require active instructions and skills plus the selected Cordis MCP rows when integrations are enabled; generic mcp.json is not proof
deepseek-harness.canaryStrategy: credential-free: per-profile dump-config and native file readback; if provider auth present → headless canary; else MODEL_BEHAVIOR NEEDS_USER
deepseek-harness.uninstallStrategy: remove managed AGENTS/Cordis blocks and owned skill projections; preserve shared plugin packages and unrelated profile/package entries unless package ownership is separately proven
limits: Host_native materialization, not managed_directory; every existing profile is handled dynamically

command-code.precedence: mod native: user mods preserved; managed mod `agent-rules` isolated; mcp.json patch; legacy .command-code migrated atomically once
command-code.mergeStrategy: mod list owned check + mcp.json patch; duplicate detection; legacy path migration atomic move
command-code.installStrategy: detect cmdc via PATH + COMMAND_CODE_HOME; install a self-contained static managed mod, native skills and MCP config
command-code.readbackStrategy: `cmdc mods list` discovery + static mod byte audit + skill and MCP readback; no .command-code fake path
command-code.canaryStrategy: credential-free static mod/skill/MCP readback; model behavior remains NEEDS_USER until observed by the host
command-code.uninstallStrategy: remove managed static mod and owned MCP entries only; preserve user mods
limits: New home is ~/.commandcode; .command-code is legacy fake; headless requires session

omp.precedence: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, then named OMP/PI profile, then default profile; preserve user content outside the managed block and preserve user mcpServers
omp.reload: new_session_or_/reload (OMP discovers native config at startup; /mcp reload reconnects configured servers)
omp.mergeStrategy: marked-block atomic swap for AGENTS.md; project skills by hash; mcp.json is changed only by explicit integration install
omp.installStrategy: detect official omp binary and active agent directory; install managed AGENTS.md block and native skills only; never report imported Claude/Codex/Cursor configuration as OMP-native proof
omp.readbackStrategy: read active OMP AGENTS.md block and enumerate one-level native skills under that exact active directory; parse mcp.json only when an explicit integration config exists
omp.canaryStrategy: credential-free version/config/skill readback; inspect /mcp list or /mcp test only in a live authenticated OMP session when a configured provider requires it
omp.uninstallStrategy: remove only OMP's managed AGENTS.md block and owned skill projections; preserve profile, user instructions, user skills and mcpServers
limits: OMP may import other tool configurations, but imported sources are never proof of OMP-native installation
A named profile changes the active user directory; install and readback resolve the same profile
Model tool visibility requires an active OMP session and is not inferred from mcp.json
